message.content:
An editorial illustration shows three caricature-like human figures around a wooden chessboard on a green background. Two slender figures in white shirts stand behind a central, larger figure in light blue. The slender figures have smooth, pale skin, thin features, and high foreheads. One on the left reaches down, touching a black chess piece, while the one on the right points a finger toward a black piece on the board. The central figure has a round, reddish face with puffy cheeks and small eyes. This figure's hands are raised with palms facing forward in a gesture of hesitation or defense.

The chessboard holds various white and black plastic or wooden pieces in mid-play. Above the illustration, a black header features red "TEMPO" text and white text: "Main Sponsor Pemilihan Ketua MA H.64," "Sebab-sebab Grup Media Bakrie Kolaps H.78," "CAWE-CAWE SAMPAI AKHIR," and a summary beginning with "Di ujung kekuasaannya..." A barcode and QR code are in the upper right. Transcribed dates are "7-13 OKTOBER 2024."
